items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: When you worked out these pieces together... we would just like to have to have a meeting, or just have to come together... we'd try either

ctx.x: You see, your partner's name was Papa Celestin. Celestin. Oh. When you worked out these pieces together, who would kind of tell you what to do? Would you be telling them on the music, working out a piece with Celestin?

You see, when we would have those things to do, we would just like to have to have a meeting, or just have to come together. You know, some fellas, if we don't add something to it, like if you'd have something in your mind that you thought would help, I would have something in my mind, but we'd try either, you see. I see.
